title: Every bullet has its billet
html_source:
Literally, “every bullet has its appropriate target” means everything/everyone has a suitable place in this world. (Billet is an army expression for home, usually temporary quarters in a civilian house.)
http://www.answers.com/Q/What_does_the_proverb_Every_bullet_has_its_billet_mean.
Gifford & Seidman, p397, have it as ‘nothing occurs by chance’.
